items.title: Russian strikes reportedly hit power substations in Vinnytsia region
items.summary: Russian strikes reportedly targeted electricity infrastructure across Ukraine's Vinnytsia region, with footage showing fires following explosions. Preliminary accounts named the 750 kV Vinnytsia substation and substations at Mohyliv-Podilskyi, Vapniarka and Tiazhylivska; damage and outages were not quantified.

items.title: Trump says US profits from arms sold to Europe for Ukraine
items.summary: President Donald Trump said the United States sells weapons to European buyers at full price without discounts and earns substantial revenue. In a Fox News interview, he said he believes European countries transfer most of those weapons to Ukraine.

items.title: Britain reportedly plans to supply Ukraine with over 1,000 long-range strike drones
items.summary: Britain plans to provide Ukraine with more than 1,000 drones intended for strikes deep inside Russia, according to a statement attributed to Andy Burnham's office. The announcement reportedly preceded a November 19 meeting of Ukraine's supporting coalition in Berlin.
